cmd:
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
fz,mut,sc=Path(sys.argv[1]),Path(sys.argv[2]),Path(sys.argv[3]); out={}
for p in sorted(mut.glob("M*.patch")):
    text=p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8"); rel=text.splitlines()[0].split("--- a/",1)[1]
    d=sc/"mcheck"/p.stem; shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True); (d/rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True); shutil.copyfile(fz/rel,d/rel)
    before=hashlib.sha256((d/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    chk=subprocess.run(["git","apply","--check",str(p)],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True)
    app=subprocess.run(["git","apply",str(p)],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True)
    src=(d/rel).read_bytes(); after=hashlib.sha256(src).hexdigest()
    try: compile(src.decode("utf-8"),rel,"exec"); comp="ok"
    except SyntaxError as e: comp=f"SyntaxError: {e}"
    files=sorted(str(x.relative_to(d)).replace("\\","/") for x in d.rglob("*") if x.is_file())
    out[p.stem]={"file":rel,"patch_sha256":hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),"frozen_sha256":before,"frozen_matches":before==hashlib.sha256((fz/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"git_apply_check_exit":chk.returncode,"git_apply_check_err":chk.stderr.strip()[:200],"git_apply_exit":app.returncode,"git_apply_err":app.stderr.strip()[:200],"mutated_sha256":after,"changed":after!=before,"compile":comp,"files_in_scratch":files,"hunks":text.count("\n@@ ")}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=1))

value.how_2.0_was_chosen: the shell computed T=$(python -c 'import adaptive; d,i=adaptive.scaled(1200); print(d)') immediately before guard.py round0-ident; adaptive.scaled() ran its own probe (bench + Get-Counter) and returned factor 2.0 -> 2400.0; only the printed 'deadline 2400.0' reached the console; that probe's dict (bench_s, cpu_other) was not written to the receipt. No rounding and no ceiling were applied by me: 2.0 is what that probe returned (max(bench/0.212, 1/(1-cpu_other)) clamped to [1, 4])
value.relation_to_guard_probe: the guard's receipted probe a few seconds later read factor 1.47 (bench 0.301 s, cpu_other 0.319); 2.0 is above it, so the deadline was looser than the receipted probe would have given (1764 s)
value.receipt_timeout: --timeout 2520 is receipt_atomic.py's own subprocess timeout (deadline + 120 s), not part of run_e4.py's argv; run_e4.py received --deadline 2400.0 (see the command entry)
value.same_pattern: record-a, record-b and replay-frozen deadlines (base 600) were computed the same way; their scaled() probes were not receipted either, their guard probes were (1.47, 1.30, 1.28); each finished in under 35 s
value.lesson: take the factor from the guard's receipted probe, or receipt the scaled() probe, so every deadline is traceable
